summary: VYX is HONEST DISTRESS, not LYING/OBSCURING. NCR Voyix is the RemainCo post-2023 Spin-Off of NCR Atleos and the September 2024 $2.45B Digital Banking Sale to Veritas Capital — i.e., the price collapse (-55%, +7% above 52w low) reflects a real shrinkage of the revenue base and the cash drain of the Digital Banking tax payment ($284M in 2025 alone). Disclosure quality is high across all eight scored claims: auditor is in place with no disagreement (CLEAN_AUDITOR_TENURE 5-year lookback); no going-concern paragraph; capital structure is plainly disclosed ($231M cash, $1.1B debt with explicit bond tranches and rates); adverse pension-lawsuit outcome (appellate affirmed, en banc denied, remanded Feb 2026) is fully disclosed with $45M accrual and the $22M NCR Atleos indemnity receivable broken out; Kalamazoo River $111M environmental reserve disclosed conservatively without netting the $54M BAT recovery receivable; ACH fraud ($34M) and April 2023 cyber ransomware ($47M cumulative) voluntarily quantified in notes. Three MODERATE_UNDERDELIVERY items: (C2) non-GAAP +$27M adjusted FCF leans on $394M of cumulative add-backs that include non-recurring Digital Banking tax but also recurring pension and environmental items, slightly overstating standalone FCF generation; (C4) Series A Preferred put-rights open March 16, 2027 with $207M redemption value versus $231M cash balance — fundable via revolver but a genuine ~10-month liquidity event horizon, mitigated by the proactive $74M preferred buyback in 2025; (C5) four out-of-period adjustments + one prior-period discontinued-ops revision in ~30 months signals weak Spin-Off-era close controls, though every adjustment is directionally unfavorable to historical results (inverse of cookie-jar pattern). Insider activity is essentially zero ($986K total sales in 540 days, 100% routine RSU-tax-withholding, signal=ROUTINE_10B5_1) and the company itself repurchased $148M of its own securities in 2025. Voyix Commerce Platform thesis is REAFFIRMED with structured KPIs in subsequent 8-Ks (+25% platform sites, +13% payment sites, +6% ARR, 80 new customers H1 2025). Composite 0.375 — between PASS and modest underdelivery, consistent with an honest small/mid-cap working through a multi-year carve-out where the price has overshot the disclosure quality. This is a name where the honesty-alpha framework SLIGHTLY DISFAVORS a short and slightly favors a value/mean-reversion long if the SaaS-platform KPIs continue to compound and the March 2027 preferred put is pre-funded.
